scope: Dated entries visible in the primary provider release notes on the capture date; not a complete history.

changes.title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna released
changes.details: Released reasoning models gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna for the Responses and Chat Completions APIs. The release notes state text and image inputs and text generation.

changes.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS models and Voices endpoint generally available
changes.details: Google marks Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS, Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS, and the Voices endpoint generally available.

changes.title: Gemini 2.5 models access update
changes.details: Google says access to the 2.5 models is limited to users who have actively used them in the past; the models are not deprecated. It directs new projects to 3.5 Flash-Lite or 3.8 Flash.

changes.title: Antigravity Agent 09-2026 released
changes.details: Google released antigravity-preview-09-2026, replacing antigravity-preview-05-2026. The release notes describe changes to built-in tool parameter casing and file-editing operations.
